title: Wellington House School, Westgate on Sea - WW1 and WW2
memorial_details:
description: WW1 Board - TO THE GLORY OF GOD AND IN MEMORY/ OF THOSE WHO FELL IN THE GREAT WAR/ 1914-1919/ (Names)/ "THEY WALK IN THE CITY THAT THEY HAVE BUILDED"/ "THE CITY OF GOD FROM EVIL SHIELDED"/
WW2 Board - TO THE GLORY OF GOD AND IN MEMORY/ OF THOSE WHO FELL IN THE WORLD WAR/ 1939-1945/ (Names)/ THESE WAR MEMORIAL BOARDS FORMERLY IN/ WELLINGTON HOUSE SCHOOL CHAPEL, WESTGATE ON SEA/ WERE TRANSFERRED TO THE PARISH CHURCH OF/ ST SAVIOUR IN 1972 AND WERE RE-DEDICATED BY/ ANTHONY, BISHOP OF DOVER ON JULY 29TH 1973.
